_comment: MarsGIS data-access source registry. Verified reachable 2026-10-11 unless marked assumed. Owned by the data-access concern. Backend reads this to know where/how to fetch each dataset. 'live_proxy' = backend fetches on demand and caches; 'bundled' = ships in repo for offline/CI.

crism_mtrdr_discovery.name: PDS Orbital Data Explorer (ODE) REST API — CRISM MTRDR discovery

query_params.results: c=count, o=ode_id only, m=metadata+footprint, f=file list, fp=files+product

crism_mtrdr_discovery.fetch_strategy: live_proxy: backend calls ODE for footprints/metadata, caches to DB; seeded offline by backend/app/seed/crism_nili_catalogue.json. Nili bbox [74,20,78,24] returns 23 MTRDR products.
crism_mtrdr_discovery.notes: ode_id is ODE's internal id; pdsid/Product_name is the PDS product. CRISM product types also include DDR, TRDR; we use MTRDR (map-projected).

crism_mtrdr_archive.name: PDS Geosciences Node — CRISM MTRDR archive (mro-m-crism-5-rdr-mptargeted-v1)
crism_mtrdr_archive.access_method: HTTPS static file download (Apache directory listings)

files_per_observation._if###j_mtr3.{img,hdr,lbl,xml}: I/F corrected map-projected spectral cube (ENVI). PRIMARY input to the engine.

envi_cube_format.projection: MRO Mars Equirectangular IAU2000, standard parallel 20N
envi_cube_format.reader: GDAL/rasterio ENVI driver (verified: gdalinfo reads it) or spectral-python envi.open(.hdr)

crism_mtrdr_archive.fetch_strategy: live_proxy: backend streams the specific _if cube + .hdr (+ _de DDR for geometry) for a chosen observation to the engine on demand, caches to object store/disk. NEVER bulk-mirror the archive. For offline/CI the engine uses the bundled synthetic cube.
crism_mtrdr_archive.notes: A single if cube is ~100–300 MB. Fetch only the cube(s) the user analyses. File URLs are discoverable via the ODE 'results=f' file list (authoritative) rather than guessing DOY paths.

crism_mica_reference_library.name: CRISM MICA Type Spectra Library (mro-m-crism-4-typespec-v1)
crism_mica_reference_library.library: 31 ratioed type spectra, 28 CRISM observations (Viviano-Beck et al. 2014, doi:10.1002/2014JE004627)

columns: 2 CRISM RATIOED I/F CORRECTED (use this for SAM)
tab_format.sam_usage: resample the cube's band wavelengths onto column1 (um; cube hdr is nm → /1000), compare against column2.

crism_mica_reference_library.fetch_strategy: live_proxy with on-disk cache (library is tiny; a backend bootstrap can mirror all 31 .tab once). Offline/CI uses the bundled SYNTHETIC carbonate_reference.csv.
crism_mica_reference_library.notes: These are ratioed type spectra (numerator/denominator ratioing already applied) — the correct reference form for SAM against ratioed scene spectra.

usgs_sim3292_geologic_map.name: USGS SIM 3292 — Global Geologic Map of Mars
usgs_sim3292_geologic_map.access_method: OGC API - Features (live, GeoJSON) + static GIS download

live_service.formats: GeoJSON (f=json / application/geo+json), JSON-LD, HTML; bbox filtering verified

usgs_sim3292_geologic_map.fetch_strategy: live_proxy: backend fetches units/contacts GeoJSON by bbox from pygeoapi and serves to Cesium as a GeoJsonDataSource overlay; cache per-bbox. Bundle a small Nili-Fossae-clipped GeoJSON (units+contacts within [74,20,78,24]) for offline. Note the 'units' collection uses prefix sim3292_global_geologic_map while contacts/structure use global_geologic_map.
usgs_sim3292_geologic_map.notes: This is a LIVE vector service (OGC API Features ~ WFS), not just a file download — ideal for a clean vector overlay with queryable unit descriptions.

mars_trek_basemaps.name: NASA Mars Trek WMTS basemaps/overlays
mars_trek_basemaps.fetch_strategy: live_proxy OR direct-from-browser: Cesium requests tiles straight from trek.nasa.gov. Backend optionally proxies/caches to control CORS and rate. No bundling (tiles are external; offline map falls back to a single low-zoom Viking tile cached in frontend assets).
mars_trek_basemaps.notes: jpg vs png differs per product; read ResourceURL from each product's WMTSCapabilities. Earlier guessed ids (Mars_MGS_MOLA_DEM_mosaic_global_463m, Mars_MO_THEMIS-IR-Day_...) returned 404 and are WRONG.

bundled_sample_data.name: Offline sample/synthetic data (ships in repo)

files.sample_crism_nili.img/.hdr: 48x48x60 ENVI BSQ float32 synthetic cube (~540 KB). GDAL-readable (verified via gdalinfo). Carbonate + olivine signatures in known regions.
files.carbonate_reference.csv: synthetic carbonate end-member on the cube's wavelength grid (wavelength_um,ratioed_if) for SAM.
files.sample_truth.json: pixel-region ground truth for deterministic test assertions.

bundled_sample_data.verified_pipeline_check: SAM(carbonate pixel, carbonate ref)=0.23deg vs SAM(olivine pixel, carbonate ref)=7.65deg — discriminates correctly, offline.
bundled_sample_data.fetch_strategy: bundled: used by CI and by the app in offline mode; the engine's loader accepts either this synthetic cube or a real fetched MTRDR cube (same ENVI contract).
bundled_sample_data.notes: SYNTHETIC. Must never be presented as a real Mars mineral detection.
